relationships.subject: Candida albicans
relationships.evidence_quote: less than 100 yeast cells elicit an inflammatory response characterized by elevated levels of interleukin-6 (IL-6) and prostaglandin E2 (PGE2)

relationships.subject: NFkB
relationships.evidence_quote: Blocking NFκB activity using Bay-11–7082 ablates inflammatory mediatory production in vestibular fibroblasts, pointing to NFκB as a master regulator of inflammation in vulvodynia

relationships.subject: Maresin 1
relationships.evidence_quote: Of the three, maresin 1 reduced PGE2 to the greatest magnitude, placing maresin 1 as a front runner for future drug development.

relationships.subject: Maresin 1
relationships.evidence_quote: SPMs, specifically maresin 1, act on more than one part of the vulvodynia mechanism by limiting inflammation and acutely inhibiting TRPV4 signaling.

relationships.subject: Maresin 1
relationships.evidence_quote: interrupting this process via twice daily topical application of the specialized pro-resolving mediator (SPM) maresin 1 increased sensitivity thresholds to pre-induction baselines in less than 4 weeks, effectively alleviating pain

key_findings: Vestibular fibroblasts from vulvodynia patients overproduce IL-6 and PGE2 in response to yeast via NFkB, with lipid dysbiosis favouring proinflammatory lipids.
Maresin 1 reduces PGE2 and vulvar allodynia in mice and inhibits TRPV4 signaling.
